party_a: Goenka Institute of Education and Research
dispute_description: Goenka Institute of Education and Research is the registered owner of the trademark GOENKA used in connection with educational institutions across India. Anjani Kumar Goenka, a former trustee and family member, claims that the trademark was assigned to him under a family settlement agreement dated 2015 in consideration of his relinquishing certain other property rights. The Institute disputes the validity of the assignment, contending that the family settlement did not constitute a valid assignment under Section 37 of the Trade Marks Act 1999 as it was not accompanied by the goodwill of the associated business, and that no assignment deed was registered with the Trade Marks Registry. Anjani Kumar Goenka has begun operating competing educational institutions under the GOENKA name. The family settlement agreement contains an arbitration clause. The Institute seeks a declaration that no valid assignment occurred and an injunction against Anjani Kumar Goenka's use of the GOENKA mark.
